name: Decline Crunch (Weighted)
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding a plate against your chest.
Cross your arms over the weight.
Curl your torso up, bringing your ribs toward your pelvis.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A crunch on a decline bench with added weight for a greater abdominal challenge.
